dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous 2D geometric narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle, creating an elongated wedge-shaped profile.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform high-intensity grayscale baseline across the entire visible dorsal area, indicating a mature white skin tone.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single, prominent longitudinal linear mark of higher contrast on the anterior mid-sagittal plane, and a secondary, smaller dark contrast spot located further posterior on the same axis.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear longitudinal indentation on the anterior dorsal axis, resulting in a localized change in topological shadowing.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent longitudinal linear scar located on the anterior dorsal midline.
